app.name: Assess launch review value
app.description: Choose whether to commission an early launch-readiness review before reserving a complete operating policy. Compare targeted, full, noisy, missing-result and late reviews against the best no-review policy, using explicit joint readiness probabilities, complete operating consequences, cash requirements and deadlines. A review can improve a reservation choice while a later mandatory gate still controls dispatch.
app.source:
# Canonical assess-value-of-learning/1 model. No domain code or computed recommendation tables.
format: assess-value-of-learning/1
module:
  id: launch-review-value
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: Assess launch review value
  description: "Choose whether to commission an early launch-readiness review before reserving a complete operating policy. Compare targeted, full, noisy, missing-result and late reviews against the best no-review policy, using explicit joint readiness probabilities, complete operating consequences, cash requirements and deadlines. A review can improve a reservation choice while a later mandatory gate still controls dispatch."
  question: "Which early review and complete response policy provides the best modeled launch payoff before reservation closes?"
  boundary: "Synthetic launch L1; order PO1.v2; supplier S1; sites SP17,H1,DC1; snapshot precommit-0; two initial unresolved relations; one optional early review; one risk-neutral supplier; Days 0–9. Operating policies, authority, remedy capacity and deterministic timing are supplied reviewed premises. This app does not authenticate records, generate shipping plans, import UBL/EPCIS documents, establish actual permissions, or authorize dispatch."
  objective:
    criterion: risk-neutral-expected-money
    unit: hypothetical USD
    timeUnit: day
    beneficiary: "Fictional supplier S1, represented by launch owner Maya"
    horizon: "One launch L1 from Day 0 through Day 9; no later launch revenue or strategic shelf-presence benefit"
  attributes:
    - id: transportRegistered
      label: SP17 registered for transportation at precommit-0
      type: boolean
    - id: itemsAligned
      label: PO1.v2 items aligned with the declared route at precommit-0
      type: boolean
    - id: directReady
      label: Initial direct-route prerequisites satisfied
      type: boolean
    - id: supplierPortalListed
      label: SP17 listed in supplier portal at precommit-0
      type: boolean
    - id: ediAccepted
      label: Accepted EDI test premise
      type: boolean
    - id: freightPrepaid
      label: Agreed prepaid freight premise
      type: boolean
    - id: authorityConfirmed
      label: Authority for the scoped candidate policies
      type: boolean
    - id: backupRemedyConfirmed
      label: Backup capacity and remedy premise
      type: boolean
  states:
    - id: ready
      label: Both initial prerequisites satisfied
      attributes:
        transportRegistered: true
        itemsAligned: true
        directReady: true
        supplierPortalListed: true
        ediAccepted: true
        freightPrepaid: true
        authorityConfirmed: true
        backupRemedyConfirmed: true
    - id: transport-gap
      label: Transportation registration gap
      attributes:
        transportRegistered: false
        itemsAligned: true
        directReady: false
        supplierPortalListed: true
        ediAccepted: true
        freightPrepaid: true
        authorityConfirmed: true
        backupRemedyConfirmed: true
    - id: alignment-gap
      label: Item and route alignment gap
      attributes:
        transportRegistered: true
        itemsAligned: false
        directReady: false
        supplierPortalListed: true
        ediAccepted: true
        freightPrepaid: true
        authorityConfirmed: true
        backupRemedyConfirmed: true
    - id: both-gaps
      label: Both initial gaps
      attributes:
        transportRegistered: false
        itemsAligned: false
        directReady: false
        supplierPortalListed: true
        ediAccepted: true
        freightPrepaid: true
        authorityConfirmed: true
        backupRemedyConfirmed: true
  actions:
    - id: standard
      label: Reserve STANDARD
      description: "Reserve the scoped direct route; ship only if the Day-4 mandatory gate passes. Any initial gap means no shipment and the declared cancellation loss."
    - id: backup
      label: Reserve BACKUP
      description: Reserve the scoped authorized hub/remedy policy. The teaching fixture assumes capacity and remedy completion by the mandatory gate in every modeled initial state.
    - id: defer
      label: Hold and DEFER
      description: "Make no launch shipment in Days 0–9; preserve records and follow the agreed hold policy."
  studies:
    - id: transport-fast
      label: "Transportation-only exact review, fast"
      reports:
        - id: transport-clear
          label: Transportation registration clear
          kind: report
        - id: transport-gap
          label: Transportation registration gap
          kind: report
    - id: full-fast
      label: "Full exact review, fast"
      reports:
        - id: clear
          label: Both prerequisites clear
          kind: report
        - id: transport-gap
          label: Transportation gap
          kind: report
        - id: alignment-gap
          label: Alignment gap
          kind: report
        - id: both-gaps
          label: Both gaps
          kind: report
    - id: screen-fast
      label: "Joint screening review, fast"
      description: Clear/flag screen has 0.9 sensitivity and specificity for any gap. A clear screen does not establish either initial prerequisite.
      reports:
        - id: clear
          label: Clear screen
          kind: report
        - id: flag
          label: Flagged screen
          kind: report
    - id: dropout-fast
      label: Full exact review with possible no report
      reports:
        - id: clear
          label: Both prerequisites clear
          kind: report
        - id: transport-gap
          label: Transportation gap
          kind: report
        - id: alignment-gap
          label: Alignment gap
          kind: report
        - id: both-gaps
          label: Both gaps
          kind: report
        - id: no-report
          label: No report
          kind: no-report
    - id: full-slow
      label: "Full exact review, slow"
      description: The exact result arrives after the reservation deadline. No early reservation or reopened reservation window is offered.
      reports:
        - id: clear
          label: Both prerequisites clear
          kind: report
        - id: transport-gap
          label: Transportation gap
          kind: report
        - id: alignment-gap
          label: Alignment gap
          kind: report
        - id: both-gaps
          label: Both gaps
          kind: report
  assumptions: [The declared four-state basis exhausts only the two modeled initial unknowns. Supplier-portal listing is a different predicate from transportation registration., "The transportation and alignment extracts are partial. Missing rows do not assert false; accepted facts must be supplied explicitly to remove incompatible states.", An early review observes the initial snapshot and does not itself repair registration or alignment. Prospective report branches are not actual evidence rows., "STANDARD and BACKUP are supplied complete operating policies with reviewed authority, quantities, terms, timing, release gates and fallback. They are not generated or proven executable here.", No shipment occurs if the Day-4 mandatory gate fails. BACKUP deterministically remedies all modeled gaps by that gate under a strong supplied premise., "Review fee plus the action cash requirement must fit the available cash. The action payoff already includes operating and cancellation costs; cash requirements are not deducted again.", "The joint current distribution and all review likelihoods are synthetic assessments, not empirical estimates or consequences of GS1/UBL vocabulary.", "Reference records retain identity mappings, systems, snapshots, locators and review status. They do not become accepted facts or economic assumptions automatically."]

definitionContract.title: Assess the value of learning
definitionContract.responsibility: Compare a best action now with finite study-and-response policies under explicit probabilities, consequences, costs and availability.
invariants: Probabilities are explicit assessments, never inferred from state counts.
Responses depend on an observable report, never the hidden state.
Study fees consume cash and are subtracted once from expected operating payoff.
Pure information value is reported only when the feasible action set is unchanged.
Reference records do not become accepted facts without an explicit declaration.
Recommendations are conditional risk-neutral monetary comparisons, not factual findings or permission to act.

module.title: Assess launch review value
module.description: Choose whether to commission an early launch-readiness review before reserving a complete operating policy. Compare targeted, full, noisy, missing-result and late reviews against the best no-review policy, using explicit joint readiness probabilities, complete operating consequences, cash requirements and deadlines. A review can improve a reservation choice while a later mandatory gate still controls dispatch.
module.question: Which early review and complete response policy provides the best modeled launch payoff before reservation closes?
module.boundary: Synthetic launch L1; order PO1.v2; supplier S1; sites SP17,H1,DC1; snapshot precommit-0; two initial unresolved relations; one optional early review; one risk-neutral supplier; Days 0–9. Operating policies, authority, remedy capacity and deterministic timing are supplied reviewed premises. This app does not authenticate records, generate shipping plans, import UBL/EPCIS documents, establish actual permissions, or authorize dispatch.

objective.beneficiary: Fictional supplier S1, represented by launch owner Maya
objective.horizon: One launch L1 from Day 0 through Day 9; no later launch revenue or strategic shelf-presence benefit

attributes.label: SP17 registered for transportation at precommit-0
PO1.v2 items aligned with the declared route at precommit-0
SP17 listed in supplier portal at precommit-0
Authority for the scoped candidate policies

actions.label: Reserve STANDARD
actions.description: Reserve the scoped direct route; ship only if the Day-4 mandatory gate passes. Any initial gap means no shipment and the declared cancellation loss.

actions.label: Reserve BACKUP
actions.description: Reserve the scoped authorized hub/remedy policy. The teaching fixture assumes capacity and remedy completion by the mandatory gate in every modeled initial state.

actions.label: Hold and DEFER
actions.description: Make no launch shipment in Days 0–9; preserve records and follow the agreed hold policy.

studies.label: Joint screening review, fast
studies.description: Clear/flag screen has 0.9 sensitivity and specificity for any gap. A clear screen does not establish either initial prerequisite.

studies.label: Full exact review with possible no report
Full exact review, slow
studies.description: The exact result arrives after the reservation deadline. No early reservation or reopened reservation window is offered.

assumptions: The declared four-state basis exhausts only the two modeled initial unknowns. Supplier-portal listing is a different predicate from transportation registration.
The transportation and alignment extracts are partial. Missing rows do not assert false; accepted facts must be supplied explicitly to remove incompatible states.
An early review observes the initial snapshot and does not itself repair registration or alignment. Prospective report branches are not actual evidence rows.
STANDARD and BACKUP are supplied complete operating policies with reviewed authority, quantities, terms, timing, release gates and fallback. They are not generated or proven executable here.
No shipment occurs if the Day-4 mandatory gate fails. BACKUP deterministically remedies all modeled gaps by that gate under a strong supplied premise.
Review fee plus the action cash requirement must fit the available cash. The action payoff already includes operating and cancellation costs; cash requirements are not deducted again.
The joint current distribution and all review likelihoods are synthetic assessments, not empirical estimates or consequences of GS1/UBL vocabulary.
Reference records retain identity mappings, systems, snapshots, locators and review status. They do not become accepted facts or economic assumptions automatically.
